title: Machine for Initializing Records
statement: For every natural number $k$, finite types $Q$ and $T$ with decidable equality, initial state $q_0\in Q$, and tag $\tau_0\in T$, there are a natural number $K$, a finite state type $P$ with decidable equality, a deterministic Turing machine $R$ with $K+2$ work tapes over the record alphabet, entry and exit states, and a natural number $C$ such that the following holds. For every binary input word $x$, natural number $s$, and binary word $w$ with $\operatorname{ofDigits}_2(w)=s$, if a configuration $d$ on the input obtained by embedding the digits of $x$ has entry state and input-head position $1$, tape $1$ agrees with the word $w$ stored from position zero on all cells from one position left of its head through $|w|$ positions right, tape $0$ is blank from one position left of its head through the record length $L=k(2s+1)+\mathrm{posWidth}(|x|)+k+4$ positions right, and every tape of index at least $2$ is blank everywhere, then for some time $t\le C(L+|w|+s+|x|+1)$ the machine reaches the configuration obtained by changing $d$ only to enter the exit state and to write on tape $0$ the joined fields of the initial configuration with state $q_0$, input $x$, blank work tapes, and tag $\tau_0$, placed over the $L$ cells starting at tape $0$'s initial head position. The machine is not in the exit state at any earlier time, and at every time through $t$ each work-tape head is at distance at most $C(L+|w|+s+1)$ from its starting position.
hypotheses_covered: Finite types $Q$ and $T$ with decidable equality
Natural number $s$ and binary word $w$ satisfying $\operatorname{ofDigits}_2(w)=s$
Initial configuration has entry state and input-head position $1$

Tape $0$ is blank on cells from one position left of its head through the record length positions right
Every tape with index at least $2$ is blank everywhere
Exit state is avoided at every time before $t$
All work-tape heads stay within distance $C(L+|w|+s+1)$ of their initial positions
Final configuration equals the specified update of $d$, including its unchanged input, tape contents outside the target interval, head positions, and output
